fields.title: After I Do
fields.author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
fields.description: From the New York Times bestselling author of The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo, comes a breath taking novel about modern marriage, the depth of family ties, and the year that one remarkable heroine spends exploring both. When Lauren and Ryan's marriage reaches the breaking point, they come up with an unconventional plan. They decide to take a year off in the hopes of finding a way to fall in love again. One year apart, and only one rule: they cannot contact each other. Aside from that, anything goes. Lauren embarks on a journey of self-discovery, quickly finding that her friends and family have their own ideas about the meaning of marriage. These influences, as well as her own healing process and the challenges of living apart from Ryan, begin to change Lauren's ideas about monogamy and marriage. She starts to question: When you can have romance without loyalty and commitment without marriage, when love and lust are no longer tied together, what do you value? What are you willing to fight for? This is a love story about what happens when the love fades. It's about staying in love, seizing love, forsaking love, and committing to love with everything you've got. And above all, After I Do is the story of a couple caught up in an old game-and searching for a new road to happily ever after.

fields.title: Air Awakens
fields.author: Elise Kova
fields.description: All Vhalla wanted for her seventeenth birthday was a book... What she got was the attention of a dark and fiery prince and a rare elemental magic. After unknowingly saving the life of the crown prince with powers she's not supposed to have, Vhalla must make a choice Embrace her sorcery and leave the quiet life she's known, or eradicate her magic entirely. But the choice isn't hers alone. Powerful forces who want to use her magic for their own gain lurk in the shadows, and the only ally Vhalla may have is the cut-throat Crown Prince Aldrik. He's everything she's been taught to fear - a sorcerer and royalty - but beneath his harsh exterior is the heart of a tortured man she finds herself dangerously drawn to. He may be the last person she ever wanted. But he's the one person she needs. And, with his training, she'll show the Empire what a quiet library girl is truly capable of. This omnibus edition contains all five books in the Air Awakens series by USA Today bestselling author Elise Kova.

fields.title: A Duel with the Vampire Lord
fields.author: Elise Kova
fields.description: Kidnapped and bound to the Vampire Lord, a woman who once served vampire hunters discovers he’s not really the villain she’s been taught to fear. Enemies become lovers in this action-packed installment of the Married to Magic novels—swoonworthy, escapist standalone reads that combine wondrous fantasy worlds with slow-burn romance from the New York Times bestselling author of Arcana Academy On the night of the blood moon, the Vampire Lord must die. As the forge maiden of Hunter’s Hamlet, Floriane knows three things for certain: One, she must craft the weapons and armor that the vampire hunters use. Two, she must keep the fact that her beloved brother, one such hunter, trains her in secret. And, three, that the Master Hunter will be the one to decide her future. But, when her brother is attacked on the night of the Blood Moon by the Vampire Lord himself, Floriane is forced to join the fray. Wanting to defend her home at all costs, Floriane fights the vampire lord, ready to give her life if it means taking his. But Ruvan doesn’t want to take her life . . . he wants her. Kidnapped and brought to the vampire castle, Floriane is now blood sworn to the vampire lord—bound in mind and body to her worst enemy. As the Vampire Lord’s captive, Floriane expected to fight. She didn't expect the battle to be with herself as she questions everything she thought she knew about her world, her purpose, and her desires. Because when Floriane’s dagger is at Ruvan’s chest, will she be able to take the heart of the man who has claimed hers? Includes a bonus scene, “Tower of Stars,” from Ruvan’s point of view Don’t miss any of the enchanting Married to Magic novels. Linked standalones to be read in any order! A DANCE WITH THE FAE PRINCE • A DUEL WITH THE VAMPIRE LORD • A DUET WITH THE SIREN KING • A DAWN WITH THE WOLF KNIGHT

fields.title: The Perfect Child
fields.author: Lucinda Berry
fields.description: A mesmerizing, unbearably tense thriller that will have you looking over your shoulder and sleeping with one eye open. This creepy, serpentine tale explores the darkest corners of parenthood and the profoundly unsettling lengths one will go to to keep a family together—no matter the consequences.

fields.title: The Hunger Games
fields.author: Suzanne Collins
fields.description: The Hunger Games is a dystopian young‑adult series by Suzanne Collins about a future nation where children are forced to fight to the death as punishment for rebellion.

fields.title: Shatter Me
fields.author: Tahereh Mafi
fields.description: Shatter Me follows Juliette Ferrars, a 17‑year‑old girl whose touch can kill, leaving her isolated and feared in a crumbling, authoritarian society ruled by the Reestablishment; after being locked away for her dangerous ability, she is suddenly pulled into a world of power struggles, moral ambiguity, and unexpected connections, forcing her to confront her own identity, trauma, and strength as she decides whether she will remain a pawn in someone else’s regime or rise to reclaim control of her life.

fields.title: Unravel me
fields.author: Tahereh Mafi
fields.description: Unravel me is the second book in the series Shatter Me, which follows Juliette Ferrars, a 17‑year‑old girl whose touch can kill, leaving her isolated and feared in a crumbling, authoritarian society ruled by the Reestablishment; after being locked away for her dangerous ability, she is suddenly pulled into a world of power struggles, moral ambiguity, and unexpected connections, forcing her to confront her own identity, trauma, and strength as she decides whether she will remain a pawn in someone else’s regime or rise to reclaim control of her life.

fields.title: Red Queen
fields.author: Victoria Aveyard
fields.description:
Red Queen is a young adult dystopian fantasy romance novel published in 2015 and written by Victoria Aveyard. It is set in the kingdom of Norta, a world divided by blood color—Reds, ordinary people living in poverty, and Silvers, an elite ruling class with superhuman abilities
Goodreads
 
The story follows Mare Barrow, a 17‑year‑old Red girl who survives by pickpocketing until she unexpectedly discovers she possesses electrokinetic powers, something no Red should have. To hide this impossibility, the Silver monarchy forces her to pose as a lost Silver noble and betroths her to a prince, pulling her into a world of political manipulation, rebellion, and betrayal

fields.title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
fields.author: Holly Jackson
fields.description: A Good Girl’s Guide to Murder” is a YA mystery by Holly Jackson following a teen investigator who reopens a supposedly solved murder case and uncovers dangerous secrets in her small town.

fields.title: Good Girl, Bad Blood
fields.author: Holly Jackson
fields.description: Good Girl, Bad Blood is the second book in Holly Jackson’s bestselling A Good Girl’s Guide to Murder series. It follows Pippa (Pip) Fitz‑Amobi, who has sworn off detective work after nearly dying during her previous investigation, but is forced back into the role when Jamie Reynolds, the older brother of her friend Connor, suddenly disappears and the police dismiss the case because he is an adult. Pip launches Season 2 of her true‑crime podcast to crowdsource clues, uncovering a trail involving a catfishing scheme, hidden identities, and a decades‑old serial‑killer case

fields.title: Renegades
fields.author: Marissa Meyer
fields.description: Renegades is a superhero-themed dystopian novel about prodigies with extraordinary powers, centering on a girl seeking vengeance and a boy devoted to justice.

fields.title: A Not So Meet Cute
fields.author: Meghan Quinn
fields.description: A Not So Meet Cute begins when out-of-work Lottie Gardner’s hunt for a wealthy rebound in Beverly Hills collides with billionaire Huxley Cane’s scheme to impress a business contact. Their deal to fake an engagement brings mansions, staged dates, and a slow, banter-filled slide into real attraction.

fields.title: The Housemaid
fields.author: Freida McFadden
fields.description: The Housemaid is a psychological thriller about Millie Calloway, a desperate young woman who becomes a live‑in maid for a wealthy Long Island family whose dark secrets pull her into a dangerous web of manipulation and deceit.

fields.title: The Housemaid’s Secret
fields.author: Freida McFadden
fields.description: Freida McFadden’s The Housemaid’s Secret follows Millie Calloway, a former felon trying to rebuild her life while working as a housemaid for wealthy clients in New York. When she accepts a job with Douglas and Wendy Garrick, she quickly senses that something is wrong. Wendy is kept locked in a bedroom, often crying, and Millie begins to suspect domestic abuse based on bruises, bloodstains, and disturbing noises

fields.title: Inheritance Games Series
fields.author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
fields.description: The Inheritance Games is a young adult novel series by author Jennifer Lynn Barnes, published by Little, Brown Books for Young Readers. The series focuses on a teenaged girl, Avery Kylie Grambs, and the Hawthorne family. It has garnered widespread acclaim for its intricate plot, twists, and engaging characters, making it a favorite among young adult readers.

fields.title: In Cold Blood
fields.author: Truman Capote
fields.description: In Cold Blood (1966) is widely regarded as one of the earliest and most influential works of true crime, a genre Capote helped define. The book recounts the real-life murder of four members of the Clutter family in Holcomb, Kansas, by two ex-convicts, Richard “Dick” Hickock and Perry Smith. Capote spent years interviewing townspeople, investigators, and the killers themselves, crafting a narrative that reads with the tension and depth of a novel while remaining grounded in factual reporting.A legally obtained book file must be added before publication.
